Hello everyone, I just uploaded a new R package on CRAN, [seqhandbook](https://cran.r-project.org/package=seqhandbook). It is initially intended to accompany a sequence analysis handbook to be published (in French) in 2021 by INED, with some data sets and a tutorial.

But it also includes functions for

- describing episodes in individual sequences,
- measuring association between domains in multidimensional sequence analysis,
- heat maps of sequence data,
- Globally Interdependent Multidimensional Sequence Analysis (GIMSA),
- smoothing sequences for index plots,
- coding sequences for Qualitative Harmonic Analysis,
- measuring stress from multidimensional scaling factors, and
- symmetrical (or canonical) Partial Least Squares.

Maybe some of them could be useful for you!

Best,\
Nicolas
